Answer: B
Reason: The red arrow in Figure 1 points to multiple cystic lucencies (pseudocavitation) within the area of consolidation in the right midzone. This finding is a characteristic radiological sign of pneumonic-type lung adenocarcinoma (formerly bronchioloalveolar carcinoma) and helps distinguish it from typical infectious pneumonia, which usually presents with homogeneous consolidation or air bronchograms without such cystic changes.
